description: This file contains functions related to building and rendering tree menus within the TestLink project, such as test specifications, test execution trees, and requirement specification trees. It includes functions to generate hierarchical data for display, filter test cases and requirements based on various criteria, and create JSON representations for ExtJS or similar UI components.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for constructing tree menu structures and configuration objects.

methods.name: generateTestSpecTree
methods.description: Generates the data for the test specification tree view, including handling filters and options, calling specialized functions for tree creation.

methods.name: prepareNode
methods.description: Prepares a test node (test case or test suite) for inclusion in the hierarchical tree, applying filters for active/inactive statuses, custom fields, keywords, and other criteria.

methods.name: renderTreeNode
methods.description: Creates a JSON-serializable structure for a tree node suitable for ExtJS or similar frameworks, including setting the proper text labels, links, and hierarchy.

methods.name: renderExecTreeNode
methods.description: Creates a JSON structure for execution tree nodes, including coloring and status indicators.

methods.name: buildKeywordsFilter
methods.description: Builds a filter object for test case keywords to be used in tree filtering.

methods.name: buildExecTypeFilter
methods.description: Builds a filter object for test case execution types.

methods.name: buildImportanceFilter
methods.description: Builds a filter object for test case importance levels.

methods.name: generate_reqspec_tree
methods.description: Creates the requirement specification hierarchy tree structure based on filters and project data.

methods.name: get_filtered_req_map
methods.description: Creates a map of requirements filtered by various criteria such as document ID, title, coverage, and custom fields.

methods.name: generateTestReqCoverageTree
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical requirement coverage tree for the specified test project, applying filters and options.

methods.name: prepare_reqspeccoverage_treenode
methods.description: Prepares a node for the requirement coverage tree, aggregating counts and filtering based on coverage and other criteria.

methods.name: filter_by_cf_values
methods.description: Recursively filters test cases and test suites based on custom field values.

methods.name: helper_filter_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up test case sets based on filtering results, removing unmatching nodes.
